Name: Vaccination coverage
Description: Default routine vaccination coverage for 9-year-old children.

Name: Vaccination schedule
Description: Default Dengvaxia routine vaccination schedule.

Name: Catch-up campaign coverage
Description: Coverage used for the optional one-off catch-up campaign in 10- to 17-year-olds.

Name: Age at routine vaccination
Description: Default age for routine vaccination.

Name: Alternative vaccination ages
Description: Age range explored in sensitivity analyses.

Name: Transmission intensity (SP9)
Description: Average proportion of 9-year-olds seropositive prior to vaccine introduction, used to characterize endemicity.

Name: Time horizon after vaccination
Description: Primary post-vaccination evaluation horizon for population impact and cost-effectiveness.

Name: Trial simulation horizon
Description: Simulation horizon for the Phase III trial comparison, including active and first year of passive follow-up.

Name: Dose interval
Description: Interval between vaccine doses in the three-dose schedule.

Name: Discount rate
Description: Discount rate applied to costs and health effects in the base-case economic analysis.

Name: DALY cost threshold
Description: Base-case threshold used to assess cost-effectiveness.

Name: Symptomatic dengue DALY burden
Description: DALYs incurred per symptomatic dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

Name: Severe dengue DALY burden
Description: DALYs incurred per severe dengue case.

Name: Public payer cost, symptomatic case
Description: Treatment cost per symptomatic dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

Name: Public payer cost, hospitalised case
Description: Treatment cost per hospitalised dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

Name: Societal cost, symptomatic case
Description: Societal cost per symptomatic dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

Name: Societal cost, hospitalised case
Description: Societal cost per hospitalised dengue case in the middle-income Latin American-like setting.

Name: Societal cost, fatal case
